rows.name: Start the Foreman's session
means: `create_session` with `model: "claude-opus-5.5"`, `workspace` = the repository, `worktree: false`, `title: "<title>"`.
A refused start is reported with its exact text.

rows.name: Own session id and title
means: `$COPILOT_AGENT_SESSION_ID`, which is also the transcript's id.
Reading the session's own title is not recorded on this host.

rows.name: Set a session's own title
means: When the host offers a way, the session sets its own title (the Foreman first); else the title stays.
The tool that does it is not recorded on this host.

rows.name: The skills
means: The same four skills, same names: `skills/chantier` (the router), `skills/chief-of-staff`, `skills/griller`, `skills/status`.
Declared in `.github/plugin/plugin.json`; how Copilot passes the arguments `foreman`, `direct` or `reload` is not known.

rows.name: Load another skill (the router)
means: Not recorded on this host: which tool loads another skill.
The four skills are declared in `.github/plugin/plugin.json`.

rows.name: List the sessions and their state
means: Not known on this host: how a session lists the sessions or tells the seat's session alive.
The seat's session always looks stopped to a new session; the "looks stopped" line of `session-start.md` is asked.

rows.name: Message another session of the user
means: `send_message` to the other session's link (a hand-over, a Griller's line).
Whether a limit applies is not recorded on this host.

rows.name: A session's link (for the seat)
means: Not recorded on this host: where a session reads its own link.
`send_message` takes a session link (see `message-chief`).

rows.name: Start a Driver or a worker
means: `task`, `mode: background`, `agent_type: <agent>`; the plugin's agent is `chantier-<role>`; no model, no effort.
The CLI prints the plugin's agent or yours; when it prints `agent=(generic)`, use `start-generic-agent` instead.

rows.name: Models at an agent's start
means: A named plugin agent runs on its file's model: given another model, the host replaces it with the file's.
A generic agent takes the model passed; the start value is the identifier (the display name in lower case, spaces as `-`, dots kept).
A model changed in the configuration starts a generic agent; the user's own agent with a model is refused.

rows.name: Start a generic agent
means: `task`, `mode: background`, the generic agent (`agent_type: general-purpose`), `model:` the printed start value.
The prompt carries the printed contract lines; its tools are the caller's, not restricted.

rows.name: The model a role ran on
means: The steering session's `events.jsonl`: `subagent.started` and `subagent.completed` carry `model`, `firstDispatchedModel`, `modelSelectionSource`.
After a start with a model, read that `model`; when it differs from the printed identifier, stop the agent's work and report both.

rows.name: Start the Spec-writer
means: `task`, `mode: background`, `agent_type: chantier-spec-writer`; no model, no effort.
The CLI prints the plugin's agent or yours; when it prints `agent=(generic)`, use `start-generic-agent` instead.

rows.name: Start the Spec critic
means: `task`, `mode: background`, `agent_type: chantier-spec-critic`; no model, no effort; Fable is not recorded on Copilot.
The CLI prints the plugin's agent or yours; when it prints `agent=(generic)`, use `start-generic-agent` instead.

rows.name: Start the Retro critic
means: `task` with `agent_type: chantier-retro-critic`; no model, no effort; Fable is not recorded on Copilot.
The CLI prints the plugin's agent or yours; when it prints `agent=(generic)`, use `start-generic-agent` instead.

rows.name: Message a Driver
means: `write_agent` to the Driver's agent id.
A stop is the same tool with `[foreman→driver <cr>] stop` (see `stop-driver`).

rows.name: Message the Chief of Staff
means: `send_message` to the Chief of Staff's session link.
The Foreman's lines and a Griller's `ready` line travel the same way.

rows.name: A Driver's final report to a Foreman's Desktop session
means: The Driver's final answer is its hand-back to its steering session (the Foreman).
In direct mode the final answer returns to the Chief of Staff that started the Driver.

rows.name: A Driver messages its steering session in direct mode
means: In direct mode the Driver's final answer returns to the Chief of Staff that started the Driver.
No earlier message from the Driver to that session is recorded on this host.

rows.name: Stop a Driver
means: `write_agent` to the Driver's agent id with `[foreman→driver <cr>] stop`.
The steering session sends it; no other route is used.

rows.name: Stop an ended Driver that wakes again
means: Not recorded on this host: the stop of an ended Driver that wakes again.
A Driver stopped from outside is read when the host says it was stopped (`foreman-lost-driver.md`).

rows.name: A CR Driver's start folder
means: A Driver starts in the folder the host gives it; no mod moves it.
The write guard's start folder does not apply here (see `write-guard`).

rows.name: Stop a background task of one's own
means: The host's stop of a background shell, within the agent's `execute` tool set.
A Driver stops its CI watch before its hand-back.

rows.name: Name the holders of the checkout's environment
means: The same commands through the host's shell tool: on Windows `Get-CimInstance Win32_Process` under `<plugin root>\.venv\`.
On macOS and Linux `ps -eo pid,ppid,args | grep -F "<plugin root>/.venv/"`, the grep line itself excluded.
Read as on Claude Code, "own" by its evidence (`--seat <this session's id>`).
Read-only: never a stop or a kill of a holder.

rows.name: Stop another session
means: Not recorded on this host: how a session stops another session.
A missing tool is reported with its text; no other route is used.

rows.name: Agent ids of the project
means: A file in `.github/agents/` or `~/.copilot/agents/`.
The plugin's own agents are `chantier-<role>`.

rows.name: Models
means: Each plugin agent's file names its model (Luna, Sol, Terra, Sonnet 5.5 or Opus 5.5); it runs when no model is passed.
Each file sets `model-policy: required` except `chantier-coder`'s; defaults are `config/chantier.defaults.yml`'s unless `hosts.<host>.roles` sets one.
An identifier is the display name in lower case, spaces as `-`, dots kept; the list comes from `just copilot-models`.
An escalated role (`coder`, `debugger`, `conflict-resolver`) starts as a generic agent on its model, printed `(generic)`.

rows.name: Skills and tools of a session
means: Not known on this host: how a session lists its skills and tools.
The Chief of Staff compares a role's needs with what it can tell.

rows.name: Preflight P2
means: `create_session` and `send_message` load.
Preflight P2 passes when both tools are available to the session.

rows.name: Ask the user a series of questions
means: The host's question tool, at most 5 questions per call, at most 4 options per question.
The reference opens each question's text; the tool's exact name and its free answer are not recorded here.

rows.name: Run the board
means: The host's background shell with the command `$CHANTIER serve --seat <id>`; `serve --restart --seat <id>` runs the same way.
Add `--forge-always` on a host that cannot run the watcher; read the first lines from the output; stop it with the host's stop of a background shell.
If the host has no background command, give the one line of `session-start.md` and go on: no workaround.

rows.name: The board's Griller
means: `copilot -p` is the intended run.
The Grill action refuses on Copilot with one line: grill in a session with the Griller skill.

rows.name: Trust of a workspace inside a trusted folder
means: Not recorded on this host: how Copilot trusts a workspace.
A refused start is reported with its exact text.

rows.name: Move a started session to another folder
means: Not recorded on this host: moving a started session to another folder.
A refused start or move is reported with its exact text; no other route is used.

rows.name: Prompt cache TTL
means: Not known on this host: how long a session's prompt cache keeps a prefix.
The `cache_ttl` default is `5m`.

rows.name: Steering wake bound (60 minutes)
means: `/every` takes whole minutes: the CLI refuses a Copilot duration that is not whole minutes.
The heartbeat uses `/every 4m` today.

rows.name: Heartbeat
means: The Chief of Staff sends the Foreman chat `/every <steering wake> chantier status --refresh --batch <batch> --epoch <n>` on its `ready <batch>`.
The wake comes from the batch's `timing: Copilot <family> models:` line, else `timing: Copilot other models:`, in `/every`'s form (`4m` by default).
The Foreman cannot end `/every`: at every pause the Chief of Staff tells the user to delete it; in direct mode it runs `/every` in its own session.
Whoever ends the heartbeat first records it with `chantier status --stop-heartbeat --batch <batch> --epoch <n>`.

rows.name: Run the watcher
means: The host's background shell with the command the `watch: not running` or `still running` line prints, as is (no `--stream`: it ends after each block).
Its end must start a turn of the idle Chief of Staff session; its output is read from the task.
Until then the Chief of Staff also runs the printed `watch --once` command at each user message.
With no background command, or an end that starts no turn, no watcher starts and one line says so: no workaround.

rows.name: The watcher when the session ends
means: Not recorded on this host: whether the host ends a background command when the session ends.
An orphaned watcher ends by the CLI's own rules, once the project's seat is another session's.

rows.name: The board when the session ends
means: Not recorded on this host: whether the host ends a background command when the session ends.
The board stops when the seat moves (the CLI); a board a watcher started stops 30 minutes after its last client.

rows.name: Limit on messages
means: Not recorded on this host.
A refused send is reported, never sent another way.

rows.name: End a subagent's turn with nothing running in the background
means: Not recorded on this host: how a subagent's turn ends with nothing running in the background.
A Driver's final answer is its hand-back (see `driver-hand-back`).

rows.name: A background subagent stops
means: Not recorded on this host: the notices that tell a background subagent stopped or finished.
A Driver's final answer is its hand-back (see `driver-hand-back`).

rows.name: A background subagent is stopped from outside
means: A Driver stopped from outside is read when the host says the Driver was stopped (`foreman-lost-driver.md`).
What a user's stop leaves in the session's record is not recorded on this host.

rows.name: Resume a stopped subagent
means: Not recorded on this host: resuming a stopped subagent.
`write_agent` to the agent id is the message to a Driver; whether it resumes a stopped one is not known.

rows.name: Compacting
means: Name no compacting command or setting to the user.
The manual reload ("chantier reload") is the only reload after a compaction.

rows.name: Reload after a compaction
means: Not done on this host: Copilot has no mod (its manifest names no hooks).
The manual reload ("chantier reload", `session-start.md`, "Reload") is the only one.

rows.name: The write guard
means: Copilot has no hook (its manifest names none): no guard refuses a write outside the `writes:` folders.
The `writes:` line is inert there; the card's rule alone covers a worker's writes.

rows.name: A Griller in a worktree
means: A Griller in a worktree sends its files as on Claude Code: by message to the seat's session, naming the absolute paths.
The message is `send_message` to the session's link (see `message-session`).

rows.name: A session in a planning surface writing in the project's clone
means: A session in a planning surface writes the project's clone and worktrees outside its own folder; that folder may be the surface's checkout or the clone.
The host must allow those folders; the remote finding is Claude Code's and was not run on Copilot.
